rationale: Price gapped down ~6.3% and has been consolidating mid-range (43.8% of today's range) with no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show choppy, overlapping price action oscillating between ~139.72 and ~140.76 with no sustained breakout in either direction.
